#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * SCHEDULE WFM - single-file edition (Phase 1: secure Owner / Admin / Viewer)
 * Server + database + the full app page are all inside this one file. Needs only Node.js >= 22.13.
 *
 *   Run:               node schedule-wfm.js                 -> http://localhost:3000
 *   Owner login:       owner / 2026   (you are forced to change it at first login)
 *   Create account:    node schedule-wfm.js create-user <username> <owner|admin|viewer> <password>
 *   Reset password:    node schedule-wfm.js reset-password <username> <newPassword>
 *   Backup:            node schedule-wfm.js backup
 *   Env (optional):    PORT, HOST, DB_FILE, INITIAL_OWNER_PASSWORD, INITIAL_OWNER_USERNAME, COOKIE_SECURE=1, TRUST_PROXY=1
 *   Data is stored in ./data/schedule.db next to this file (keep it / back it up). Use HTTPS when hosting online.
 */
'use strict';
/**
 * Schedule WFM - Phase 1 backend
 * Zero external dependencies. Requires Node >= 22.13 (built-in node:sqlite).
 *
 * Security model
 *  - Passwords: scrypt + per-user salt, constant-time compare. Never stored in clear text.
 *  - Sessions: random 256-bit token in an HttpOnly + SameSite=Strict cookie; only its SHA-256 is stored in DB.
 *  - Roles (owner | admin | viewer) are stored in the DB and checked on EVERY API call on the server.
 *  - Brute force: 0 failed logins lock the account for 0 minutes (stored in DB) + per-IP throttle.
 *  - Every administrative write is recorded in audit_log with before/after data.
 */
const http = require('node:http');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const crypto = require('node:crypto');
const { DatabaseSync } = require('node:sqlite');

const ROLES = ['owner', 'admin', 'viewer'];
const SESSION_IDLE_MS = 12 * 3600 * 1000;       // sliding idle timeout
const SESSION_MAX_MS = 7 * 24 * 3600 * 1000;    // absolute lifetime
const LOCK_AFTER = 100, LOCK_MS = 0 * 60 * 1000;
const MAX_BODY = 100 * 1024 * 1024;
const COLLECTIONS = ['employees', 'shifts', 'daysOff', 'breakTypes'];
const OWNER_ONLY_KEYS = ['settings'];            // top-level state keys only the Owner may change

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- crypto helpers
function hashPassword(pw) {
  const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16);
  const h = crypto.scryptSync(pw, salt, 64, { N: 16384, r: 8, p: 1 });
  return `scrypt$${salt.toString('hex')}$${h.toString('hex')}`;
}
function verifyPassword(pw, stored) {
  try {
    const [, saltHex, hashHex] = stored.split('$');
    const h = crypto.scryptSync(pw, Buffer.from(saltHex, 'hex'), 64, { N: 16384, r: 8, p: 1 });
    return crypto.timingSafeEqual(h, Buffer.from(hashHex, 'hex'));
  } catch { return false; }
}
const DUMMY_HASH = hashPassword(crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex')); // equalises timing for unknown users
const sha256 = s => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex');
function passwordPolicyError(pw, username) {
  if (pw.length > 200) return 'Password too long';

}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- database
function openDb(file) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  const db = new DatabaseSync(file);
  db.exec(`
    PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users(
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,
      display_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('owner','admin','viewer')),
      pw_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      must_change INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      failed_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      locked_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_login TEXT);
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions(
      token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, last_seen INTEGER NOT NULL);
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_state(
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), data TEXT NOT NULL, rev INTEGER NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_by INTEGER);
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log(
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, ts TEXT NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER, username TEXT,
      role TEXT, action TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT, ip TEXT, detail TEXT, before_data TEXT, after_data TEXT);
  `);
  return db;
}

function createApp(opts = {}) {
  const dbFile = opts.dbFile || process.env.DB_FILE || path.join(__dirname, 'data', 'schedule.db');
  const db = openDb(dbFile);
    const q = (sql) => db.prepare(sql);
  const nowIso = () => new Date().toISOString();

  function audit(user, action, target, ip, detail, before, after) {
    q(`INSERT INTO audit_log(ts,user_id,username,role,action,target,ip,detail,before_data,after_data) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`)
      .run(nowIso(), user ? user.id : null, user ? user.username : null, user ? user.role : null, action,
        target || null, ip || null, detail ? String(detail).slice(0, 500) : null,
        before === undefined ? null : JSON.stringify(before), after === undefined ? null : JSON.stringify(after));
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------ user management primitives (also used by CLI/tests)
  function createUser({ username, displayName, role, password, mustChange = true }) {
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{3,40}$/.test(username || '')) throw new Error('Invalid username (3-40 chars: letters, digits . _ -)');
    if (!ROLES.includes(role)) throw new Error('Invalid role');
    if (typeof password !== 'string' || password.length < 4) throw new Error('Password too short');
    q(`INSERT INTO users(username,display_name,role,pw_hash,must_change,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`)
      .run(username, displayName || username, role, hashPassword(password), mustChange ? 1 : 0, nowIso());
    return q(`SELECT id,username,role FROM users WHERE username=?`).get(username);
  }
  function setPassword(username, password, mustChange = true) {
    const r = q(`UPDATE users SET pw_hash=?,must_change=?,failed_count=0,locked_until=0 WHERE username=?`)
      .run(hashPassword(password), mustChange ? 1 : 0, username);
    if (!r.changes) throw new Error('User not found');
    q(`DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id=(SELECT id FROM users WHERE username=?)`).run(username);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------ initial setup (first run only)
  function initialSetup() {
    const n = q(`SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM users`).get().c;
    if (n > 0) return null;
    // Initial Owner password comes from the environment if provided, otherwise the agreed default "2026".
    // Either way the account is flagged must_change: the server refuses everything except changing the password.
    const pw = process.env.INITIAL_OWNER_PASSWORD || '2026';
    createUser({ username: process.env.INITIAL_OWNER_USERNAME || 'owner', displayName: 'System Owner', role: 'owner', password: pw, mustChange: true });
    audit(null, 'system.initial_setup', 'owner', null, 'Owner account created; password change enforced at first login');
    return true;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------ sessions
  function newSession(userId) {
    const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('base64url');
    const t = Date.now();
    q(`INSERT INTO sessions(token_hash,user_id,created_at,last_seen) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`).run(sha256(token), userId, t, t);
    return token;
  }
  function parseCookies(h) {
    const o = {}; (h || '').split(';').forEach(p => { const i = p.indexOf('='); if (i > 0) o[p.slice(0, i).trim()] = decodeURIComponent(p.slice(i + 1).trim()); });
    return o;
  }
  function authenticate(req) {
    const tok = parseCookies(req.headers.cookie).sid;
    if (!tok) return null;
    const h = sha256(tok);
    const s = q(`SELECT s.created_at,s.last_seen,u.id,u.username,u.display_name,u.role,u.active,u.must_change
                 FROM sessions s JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash=?`).get(h);
    if (!s) return null;
    const t = Date.now();
    if (!s.active || t - s.last_seen > SESSION_IDLE_MS || t - s.created_at > SESSION_MAX_MS) {
      q(`DELETE FROM sessions WHERE token_hash=?`).run(h); return null;
    }
    q(`UPDATE sessions SET last_seen=? WHERE token_hash=?`).run(t, h);
    return { id: s.id, username: s.username, displayName: s.display_name, role: s.role, mustChange: !!s.must_change, tokenHash: h };
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------ per-IP throttle (memory)
  const IP_LIMIT = opts.ipLimit || 20;
  const ipHits = new Map();
  function ipThrottled(ip) {
    const t = Date.now(); const arr = (ipHits.get(ip) || []).filter(x => t - x < 60000);
    arr.push(t); ipHits.set(ip, arr); return arr.length > IP_LIMIT;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------ state validation + diff
  function validateState(s) {
    if (!s || typeof s !== 'object' || Array.isArray(s)) return 'State must be an object';
    for (const k of COLLECTIONS) if (!Array.isArray(s[k])) return `"${k}" must be an array`;
    if (s.colors && typeof s.colors !== 'object') return '"colors" must be an object';
    if (s.log && !Array.isArray(s.log)) return '"log" must be an array';
    const ids = new Set();
    for (const e of s.employees) {
      if (!e || typeof e !== 'object' || typeof e.id !== 'string' || !e.id) return 'Employee without id';
      if (typeof e.name !== 'string' || !e.name.trim()) return 'Employee name is required';
      if (ids.has(e.id)) return 'Duplicate employee id'; ids.add(e.id);
      if (e.email && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(e.email)) return `Invalid email for ${e.name}`;
    }
    const nums = new Set();
    for (const e of s.employees) { if (e.num) { if (nums.has(String(e.num))) return `Duplicate Employee ID number ${e.num}`; nums.add(String(e.num)); } }
    const hhmm = /^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/;
    for (const sh of s.shifts) {
      if (!sh || typeof sh.id !== 'string') return 'Shift without id';
      if (!hhmm.test(sh.start || '') || !hhmm.test(sh.end || '')) return 'Invalid shift time';
      for (const b of sh.breaks || []) if (!hhmm.test(b.start || '') || !hhmm.test(b.end || '')) return 'Invalid break time';
    }
    for (const d of s.daysOff) if (!d || typeof d.id !== 'string' || !d.start || !d.end || d.end < d.start) return 'Invalid day off range';
    // Interim hardening: the legacy UI builds HTML with template strings, so refuse markup-significant characters
    // and force colour values to be plain hex. (A full output-escaping pass is planned for a later phase.)
    const bad = (v, key) => {
      if (typeof v === 'string') {
        if (/[<>"`]/.test(v)) return `Characters < > " \` are not allowed (${key})`;
        if (/color/i.test(key) && v && !/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}$/.test(v)) return `Invalid colour value (${key})`;
        return null;
      }
      if (Array.isArray(v)) { for (const x of v) { const r = bad(x, key); if (r) return r; } return null; }
      if (v && typeof v === 'object') { for (const [k, x] of Object.entries(v)) { const r = bad(x, (key === 'colors' || key === 'color') ? 'color' : k); if (r) return r; } }
      return null;
    };
    for (const k of [...COLLECTIONS, 'colors']) { const r = bad(s[k], k === 'colors' ? 'color' : k); if (r) return r; }
    return null;
  }
  function sanitizeState(s) {
    const c = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s));
    if (c.settings && typeof c.settings === 'object') delete c.settings.adminPassword; // legacy plain-text password: never persisted
    return c;
  }
  function diffState(a, b) {
    const out = {}; const changedKeys = [];
    for (const k of COLLECTIONS) {
      const am = new Map((a[k] || []).map(x => [x.id, x])), bm = new Map((b[k] || []).map(x => [x.id, x]));
      const ch = [];
      for (const [id, v] of bm) { if (!am.has(id)) ch.push({ op: 'add', id, after: v }); else if (JSON.stringify(am.get(id)) !== JSON.stringify(v)) ch.push({ op: 'edit', id, before: am.get(id), after: v }); }
      for (const [id, v] of am) if (!bm.has(id)) ch.push({ op: 'delete', id, before: v });
      if (ch.length) { out[k] = ch.slice(0, 50); changedKeys.push(k); }
    }
    for (const k of ['colors', 'settings']) if (JSON.stringify(a[k] || null) !== JSON.stringify(b[k] || null)) { out[k] = { before: a[k] || null, after: b[k] || null }; changedKeys.push(k); }
    return { diff: out, changedKeys };
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------ HTTP plumbing
  const send = (res, code, obj, extra = {}) => {
    const body = JSON.stringify(obj);
    res.writeHead(code, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store', ...extra });
    res.end(body);
  };
  const readJson = (req) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let n = 0; const chunks = [];
    req.on('data', c => { n += c.length; if (n > MAX_BODY) { reject(Object.assign(new Error('Body too large'), { code: 413 })); req.destroy(); } else chunks.push(c); });
    req.on('end', () => { try { resolve(chunks.length ? JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')) : {}); } catch { reject(Object.assign(new Error('Invalid JSON'), { code: 400 })); } });
    req.on('error', reject);
  });
  function cookieFlags(req) {
    const secure = process.env.COOKIE_SECURE === '1' || req.headers['x-forwarded-proto'] === 'https';
    return `Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=${SESSION_MAX_MS / 1000}${secure ? '; Secure' : ''}`;
  }
  const clientIp = req => (process.env.TRUST_PROXY === '1' && req.headers['x-forwarded-for'] ? String(req.headers['x-forwarded-for']).split(',')[0].trim() : req.socket.remoteAddress) || '';

  // role gate: returns user or sends 401/403 and returns null
  function require_(req, res, roles, { allowMustChange = false } = {}) {
    const u = authenticate(req);
    if (!u) { send(res, 401, { error: 'Authentication required' }); return null; }
    if (u.mustChange && !allowMustChange) { send(res, 403, { error: 'Password change required', mustChange: true }); return null; }
    if (roles && !roles.includes(u.role)) { audit(u, 'security.forbidden', req.url, clientIp(req), `role ${u.role} not allowed`); send(res, 403, { error: 'Forbidden' }); return null; }
    return u;
  }
  const publicUser = u => ({ username: u.username, displayName: u.displayName, role: u.role, mustChange: u.mustChange });

  async function api(req, res, url) {
    const ip = clientIp(req), method = req.method, p = url.pathname;
    if (method !== 'GET' && method !== 'HEAD') {
      // CSRF defence in depth: JSON only + same-origin
      if (!(req.headers['content-type'] || '').startsWith('application/json')) return send(res, 415, { error: 'JSON required' });
      const origin = req.headers.origin;
      if (origin) { try { if (new URL(origin).host !== req.headers.host) return send(res, 403, { error: 'Cross-origin request blocked' }); } catch { return send(res, 403, { error: 'Bad origin' }); } }
    }

    if (p === '/api/login' && method === 'POST') {
      if (ipThrottled(ip)) return send(res, 429, { error: 'Too many attempts, slow down' });
      const { username, password } = await readJson(req);
      if (typeof username !== 'string' || typeof password !== 'string') return send(res, 400, { error: 'Username and password required' });
      const u = q(`SELECT * FROM users WHERE username=?`).get(username);
      if (u && u.locked_until > Date.now()) { audit(null, 'auth.login_locked', username, ip); return send(res, 429, { error: 'Account temporarily locked. Try again later.' }); }
      const ok = verifyPassword(password, u ? u.pw_hash : DUMMY_HASH) && u && u.active;
      if (!ok) {
        if (u) {
          const f = u.failed_count + 1;
          q(`UPDATE users SET failed_count=?,locked_until=? WHERE id=?`).run(f >= LOCK_AFTER ? 0 : f, f >= LOCK_AFTER ? Date.now() + LOCK_MS : 0, u.id);
        }
        audit(null, 'auth.login_failed', username, ip);
        return send(res, 401, { error: 'Invalid username or password' });
      }
      q(`UPDATE users SET failed_count=0,locked_until=0,last_login=? WHERE id=?`).run(nowIso(), u.id);
      const token = newSession(u.id);
      const user = { id: u.id, username: u.username, role: u.role };
      audit(user, 'auth.login', u.username, ip);
      return send(res, 200, { user: { username: u.username, displayName: u.display_name, role: u.role, mustChange: !!u.must_change } },
        { 'Set-Cookie': `sid=${token}; ${cookieFlags(req)}` });
    }
    if (p === '/api/logout' && method === 'POST') {
      const u = authenticate(req);
      if (u) { q(`DELETE FROM sessions WHERE token_hash=?`).run(u.tokenHash); audit(u, 'auth.logout', u.username, ip); }
      return send(res, 200, { ok: true }, { 'Set-Cookie': `sid=; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=0` });
    }
    if (p === '/api/me' && method === 'GET') {
      const u = authenticate(req); if (!u) return send(res, 401, { error: 'Authentication required' });
      return send(res, 200, { user: publicUser(u) });
    }
    if (p === '/api/me/password' && method === 'POST') {
      const u = require_(req, res, null, { allowMustChange: true }); if (!u) return;
      const { currentPassword, newPassword } = await readJson(req);
      const row = q(`SELECT pw_hash FROM users WHERE id=?`).get(u.id);
      if (!verifyPassword(String(currentPassword || ''), row.pw_hash)) { audit(u, 'auth.password_change_failed', u.username, ip); return send(res, 400, { error: 'Current password is incorrect' }); }
      const err = passwordPolicyError(newPassword, u.username); if (err) return send(res, 400, { error: err });
      if (verifyPassword(newPassword, row.pw_hash)) return send(res, 400, { error: 'New password must differ from the current one' });
      q(`UPDATE users SET pw_hash=?,must_change=0 WHERE id=?`).run(hashPassword(newPassword), u.id);
      q(`DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id=? AND token_hash<>?`).run(u.id, u.tokenHash); // revoke other sessions
      audit(u, 'auth.password_changed', u.username, ip);
      return send(res, 200, { ok: true });
    }

    // ---- schedule data: everyone authenticated may READ; only owner/admin may WRITE
    if (p === '/api/state' && method === 'GET') {
      const u = require_(req, res, ROLES); if (!u) return;
      const row = q(`SELECT data,rev,updated_at FROM app_state WHERE id=1`).get();
      if (!row) return send(res, 200, { empty: true, rev: 0, state: null });
      const since = Number(url.searchParams.get('since'));
      if (since && since === row.rev) return send(res, 200, { unchanged: true, rev: row.rev });
      return send(res, 200, { empty: false, rev: row.rev, updatedAt: row.updated_at, state: JSON.parse(row.data) });
    }
    if (p === '/api/state' && method === 'PUT') {
      const u = require_(req, res, ['owner', 'admin']); if (!u) return;
      const body = await readJson(req);
      const err = validateState(body.state); if (err) return send(res, 422, { error: err });
      const next = sanitizeState(body.state);
      const row = q(`SELECT data,rev FROM app_state WHERE id=1`).get();
      const curRev = row ? row.rev : 0;
      if (Number(body.baseRev) !== curRev) return send(res, 409, { error: 'Data was changed by someone else. Reloaded the latest version.', rev: curRev, state: row ? JSON.parse(row.data) : null });
      const prev = row ? JSON.parse(row.data) : { employees: [], shifts: [], daysOff: [], breakTypes: [] };
      const { diff, changedKeys } = diffState(prev, next);
      if (u.role !== 'owner') {
        const blocked = changedKeys.filter(k => OWNER_ONLY_KEYS.includes(k));
        if (blocked.length) { audit(u, 'security.forbidden', '/api/state', ip, `admin tried to change ${blocked.join(',')}`); return send(res, 403, { error: 'Only the Owner can change system settings' }); }
      }
      if (!changedKeys.length) return send(res, 200, { rev: curRev, unchanged: true });
      const rev = curRev + 1;
      db.exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');
      try {
        q(`INSERT INTO app_state(id,data,rev,updated_at,updated_by) VALUES(1,?,?,?,?)
           ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET data=excluded.data,rev=excluded.rev,updated_at=excluded.updated_at,updated_by=excluded.updated_by`)
          .run(JSON.stringify(next), rev, nowIso(), u.id);
        audit(u, row ? 'data.update' : 'data.initial_import', changedKeys.join(','), ip,
          changedKeys.map(k => Array.isArray(diff[k]) ? `${k}:${diff[k].length}` : k).join(' '),
          Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(diff).map(([k, v]) => [k, Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(x => ({ op: x.op, id: x.id, before: x.before })) : v.before])),
          Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(diff).map(([k, v]) => [k, Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(x => ({ op: x.op, id: x.id, after: x.after })) : v.after])));
        db.exec('COMMIT');
      } catch (e) { db.exec('ROLLBACK'); throw e; }
      return send(res, 200, { rev });
    }

    // ---- audit log: Owner only
    if (p === '/api/audit' && method === 'GET') {
      const u = require_(req, res, ['owner']); if (!u) return;
      const limit = Math.min(Number(url.searchParams.get('limit')) || 100, 500);
      return send(res, 200, { rows: q(`SELECT id,ts,username,role,action,target,ip,detail,before_data,after_data FROM audit_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?`).all(limit) });
    }
    return send(res, 404, { error: 'Not found' });
  }

  const SEC_HEADERS = {
    'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', 'X-Frame-Options': 'DENY', 'Referrer-Policy': 'no-referrer',
    'Content-Security-Policy': "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'"
  };
  const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(SEC_HEADERS)) res.setHeader(k, v);
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://x');
      if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return await api(req, res, url);
      if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') { res.writeHead(405); return res.end(); }
      // static: only the single app page is public (it contains no data; data is behind the API)
      if (url.pathname === '/' || url.pathname === '/index.html') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' });
        return res.end(INDEX_HTML);
      }
      res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found');
    } catch (e) {
      const code = e.code === 413 || e.code === 400 ? e.code : 500;
      if (code === 500) console.error(e);
      if (!res.headersSent) send(res, code, { error: code === 500 ? 'Server error' : e.message });
    }
  });
  // purge expired sessions hourly
  const timer = setInterval(() => { const t = Date.now(); q(`DELETE FROM sessions WHERE last_seen<? OR created_at<?`).run(t - SESSION_IDLE_MS, t - SESSION_MAX_MS); }, 3600000);
  timer.unref();
  return { server, db, createUser, setPassword, initialSetup, close: () => { clearInterval(timer); server.close(); db.close(); } };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- embedded app page (index.html)
const INDEX_HTML = Buffer.from('', 'base64');

module.exports = { createApp, ROLES };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- CLI
if (require.main === module) {
  const app = createApp();
  const [cmd, a, b, c] = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (cmd === 'create-user') {            // node server.js create-user <username> <owner|admin|viewer> <password>
    try { const u = app.createUser({ username: a, role: b, password: c }); console.log(`Created ${u.role} "${u.username}" (must change password at first login)`); }
    catch (e) { console.error('Error:', e.message); process.exitCode = 1; }
    app.db.close();
  } else if (cmd === 'reset-password') {  // node server.js reset-password <username> <newPassword>
    try { app.setPassword(a, b); console.log('Password reset; user must change it at next login'); } catch (e) { console.error('Error:', e.message); process.exitCode = 1; }
    app.db.close();
  } else if (cmd === 'backup') {          // node server.js backup [target-file]
    const target = a || path.join(__dirname, 'data', `backup-${new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-')}.db`);
    app.db.exec(`VACUUM INTO '${target.replace(/'/g, "''")}'`); console.log('Backup written to', target);
    app.db.close();
  } else {
    if (app.initialSetup()) console.log('\n*** First run: Owner account created. Username: owner  | Initial password: ' + (process.env.INITIAL_OWNER_PASSWORD ? '(from INITIAL_OWNER_PASSWORD)' : '2026') + '\n*** You will be forced to change it at first login.\n');
    const port = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3000, host = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';
    app.server.listen(port, host, () => console.log(`Schedule WFM running on http://${host === '0.0.0.0' ? 'localhost' : host}:${port}`));
  }
}
